# Gooey section edge: Wave, a liquid scroll effect between page sections

Broad flowing crest pulled by scroll speed. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding agents.

[![Gooey section edge: Wave, a liquid scroll effect between page sections](demo/preview.jpg)](https://loouis.github.io/skills/gooey-section-wave/demo/)

[Open the live demo](https://loouis.github.io/skills/gooey-section-wave/demo/) · [Demo source](demo/index.html) · [Demo prompt](demo/PROMPT.md) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [References](REFERENCES.md)

## What it does

Rebuilds the 'Wave' gooey section edge from Louis's motion labs (gooey-sections.html, tab 1): a broad, flowing crest with a soft shoulder trailing to its right. The boundary between two page sections acts like a liquid surface driven by scroll speed. Use this skill whenever the user asks for the wave goo, the wave edge, the wave section divider, 'the wave one' or Louis's favourite goo, or for gooey sections tab 1, on a plain HTML page, a Webflow site or a React/Next.js app, even if they only name the feel. It ships a verified 1:1 port of the lab engine, so the result matches the lab exactly.

## Use it

- **Claude Code**: copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/gooey-section-wave/` (or run `python3 install.py` from the repository root), then ask in your own words or call `/gooey-section-wave`.
- **Codex**: copy this folder into your Codex skills directory and ask: "Use $gooey-section-wave to add the wave gooey edge between the sections of this page."
- **Other agents**: point the agent at [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) and let it follow the steps.

**Tags:** gooey effect · scroll animation · liquid section divider · canvas · Webflow · React · Next.js
